journal_lines: Spruce stands. Cold air. Smells like winter stored inside wood.
Good straight grain. These trees grow slow and honest.
A cavity in the trunk. Old axe marks. Someone didn't finish.
Snow came down all at once when the trunk finally went.
The spruce grows close together. Working in tight spaces.
Cold enough to see breath all day. The wood was worth it.
Snow packed between the roots. The footing was careful.
The grain in this spruce is fine and close. Good work.
The crown came down first and buried the base briefly.
A bear watched from above on the ridge. Worked faster.
Spruce sap on the paws. Takes a while to wear off.
Found a stand of fir mixed in with the spruce. Different timber.
The cold snapped a branch clean off. Useful already.
The snow made the cut trunk hard to move. Eventually managed.
Working in the taiga at night is not recommended. It is dark.
The needles make the floor soft and the footing uncertain.
